name: Donut chart
purpose: Composition / proportion as a ring with a centre total — the round-one dataviz kit's donut graduated into canon, FULL LAYER-2 restored (chart-revisit wave lane ②, 2026-07-24, exemplar pattern): segment popover · table-view popover · legend-as-filter/isolate/highlight · value ⇄ % segmented toggle (baked variant groups) · optional title + H-stack head · high-contrast remap. PROVISIONAL-AGENT: promoted from the PARKED kit (9 review rounds, not signed off); ring geometry and both labelling variants are OBSERVED kit values.

props.name: labelling
props.$note: spider = letter on a short leader outside the ring + vertical legend [swatch][letter][name]; direct = name + value in place, no legend (its own colour-independent channel). The kit's third variant — letters ON segments — is NOT promoted: white letters on series fills collide with type26-013 white-type-red-only; Dave's Batch-2 #7 comparison stays open (receipted).

props.name: slices
props.$note: Maximum 6 (dv-pie-009); more → combine smallest into 'Other'. Values must sum to the displayed centre total (dv-pie-010, data-total attr).

props.name: total
props.$note: Centre total — .t-cm-figure-3 (24px/500; kit's 22px promoted to the ramp step, DV-D05).

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state = the Empty-state pattern by reference.

props.name: valueMode
props.$note: Menu item 5 (ruled in): the Segmented-control atom (.seg.sm) drives BAKED variant groups (data-dv-view) — centre total, direct labels AND the table column mirror the active mode. JS-off = value view. Tips/aria carry both readings always.

props.name: title
props.$note: Optional visible title (.dv-title, t-cm-section-label) in the H-stack head; sr-only figcaption still names the chart when absent.

variants.name: spider + legend
variants.use: Default composition view; letters bridge chart ↔ legend (§04.3).

variants.name: direct labels
variants.use: Self-contained view (print/export-friendly); name + £value · % on each leader.

variants.name: no data
variants.use: Empty-state pattern in the chart frame.

responsive.rule: DV-D02 excluded donuts from width-compression (compressing a circle distorts) — fixed geometry; .dv-stage scrolls if the container is narrower.

mustNotNeighbour: A second composition chart of the same data (pick one)
Charts re-using these series colours for different data (dv-014)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="img", aria-label carries subject + total.
accessibility.name: Figcaption names the chart; every segment carries aria-label == data-tip == table (name, value, percentage — one source); the real table is the full data surface.
accessibility.keyboard: Segments = focus stops (tabindex 0 → dvTip on focus); legend rows = buttons (Enter toggles, Shift+Enter isolates); seg view switch + CSV + table dropdown all native buttons; table panel takes focus on open, Esc returns it.
accessibility.focus: 2px ink outline on segments/buttons/panel (focus-visible); seg buttons inset −2.
accessibility.nonText: Segment fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes; identity = letter/name + position + table, never colour alone (1.4.1); 2px page strokes keep adjacent segments separable.

antiPatterns: Segment values that don't sum to the centre total (dv-pie-010)
Gapless segments without the 2px page stroke (dv-004)
White letters on segment fills (type26-013 — white type is red-only; label in ink outside the ring)
A donut without its real data table (dv-005)
Proportionally scaling the ring down (DV-D02 donut exclusion — it distorts)
Signalling a control's off state by dimming alone (ADR-0014 inactive ≠ disabled — the legend off-state is the hollow-swatch + data/axis grey recipe)
Recomputing arc geometry at runtime outside the sweep hook (geometry is generation-time; behaviour only toggles baked variants)
